# Third-party material in this skill

This directory contains copies of open-source material that Google did not write. Each
subdirectory carries the upstream project's own licence file, unmodified. Nothing in this
directory is a Google work, and nothing here is endorsed by, affiliated with, or sponsored
by its authors.

## vendor/design-rules/

Design guidance copied from the open-source project Hallmark.

  Project    Hallmark
  Source     https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark
  Revision   13ac0ec7e148655948100b6396439e481361d690 (v1.1.0)
  Retrieved  2026-08-19
  Licence    MIT
  Copyright  Copyright (c) 2026 Hallmark contributors

The full text of the MIT Licence as published by that project is reproduced verbatim in
vendor/design-rules/LICENSE and applies to every file in that directory.

This is a partial copy, and it has been rearranged. vendor/design-rules/ORIGIN.md lists
every upstream file that was included, every file that was left out, and every change made
to what was included, with SHA-256 values so any copy can be checked against the source.

The name "Hallmark" appears here only to identify the project the material came from. It is
not a name applied to this lab, to this skill, or to anything a learner sees. No trademark
rights are claimed, and no affiliation is implied.

## Where our rules and theirs disagree

vendor/OVERRIDES.md lists every place this lab's honesty contract, or its offline
constraint, supersedes a rule in the copied material. The honesty contract wins in all
cases. No vendored file was edited to make it agree with us; the disagreements are recorded
instead, so that whose rule is whose stays legible.
